results.source_quote: During training, Anthropic says, it "took steps to limit advances in the specific research capabilities that could most directly accelerate AI development." prompts.triage:
Before this daily AI briefing is published, check it against a minimal ethical floor. Below are the claim audit's FAIL rows, the briefing (spoken script and takeaways) and the source texts.

A row falls below the floor only if the briefing invents a quote (words the person or source never said), pins a claim, quote or action on the wrong person or company, reports an event that never happened, or exposes non-public personal information. Overstatement, stronger framing, turning a conditional into a certainty, missing caveats and imprecise numbers or dates do not, even about a named person; they stay in the public audit.

Reply with only JSON: {"violations":[{"id":"FAIL row id","category":"invented_quote|misattribution|fabricated_event|privacy_safety","artifact":"episode|takeaways","quote":"exact briefing text","why":"one sentence"}]}. Use an empty list when nothing falls below the floor.
prompts.edit:
Fix only the items below in this briefing so each matches the sources, changing as few words as possible. Keep the script natural to hear and leave everything else exactly as written.

Reply with only JSON: {"edits":[{"artifact":"episode|takeaways","find":"exact current text","replace":"corrected text"}]}. Each find must appear exactly once in that artifact.
